title: ISS Carbon Dioxide Removal Assembly (CDRA) Maintenance
author: NASA
caption: NASA astronauts working on the International Space Station Carbon Dioxide Removal Assembly (CDRA), which scrubs cabin CO2 to prevent hypercapnic symptoms.
alt_text: Two astronauts inside the ISS Destiny laboratory working on the Carbon Dioxide Removal Assembly rack.
clinical_relevance: Illustrates spacecraft environmental CO2 scrubbing hardware directly tied to preventing CO2-induced headaches (CLIFF-040, p.1, p.5).
